name: tells
about: Phrases and sentence shapes that make prose read machine-made. Each rule is a candidate for a reader to judge, not proof of who wrote the text.
credits: Sam Zoloth's kill-word list and Margin writing rules: https://szoloth.com

the part that — designation; the reader decides what matters

unfalsifiable 'nobody' claim — earned only with a named mechanism
animate verb on an inanimate subject — say what happens (entry 4)
